description: Weekly-aggregated irrigation product - Po basin is a dataset listed in Environmental Data Platform - Discovery (EDP - Discovery), a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Eurac Research. A 1 km experimental dataset of weekly-aggregated irrigation estimates retrieved through the SM-based inversion approach implemented with RT1 Sentinel-1 soil moisture and ERA5-Land rainfall and GLEAM 1 km potential evaporation. Coverage: Europe. Its keywords include IRRIGATION WATER USE, 4DMED, IRRIGATION, SENTINEL-1. The listing shows 2026-09-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-eurac-edp.
